text:
sara: quick heads-up — canary cluster in us-central started failing provisioning after we staged nvidia 535 yesterday evening. a few nodes bootlooping and kubelet never registers.
provisioning-bot: [alert] node i-0a12b3c4d5e6 failed to join: nvhost reset detected; retrying (3/5)
kai: seeing the same on two canaries. logs show repeated nvhost resets + dkms rebuild errors during image init. not a simple modprobe timeout.
noah: can you paste the journal snippet? also which kernel is used on those canaries (ami build id)?
lin: kernel 5.15.0-1085, image: rwinf-worker-canary-2026-03-16. journal excerpt:
```
Mar 16 02:14:23 host kernel: nvidia 0000:01:00.0: nvhost: reset: hw_watchdog
Mar 16 02:14:23 host kernel: nvidia: probe of 0000:01:00.0 failed with error -5
Mar 16 02:14:23 host dkms: ERROR: Cannot complete make.
Mar 16 02:14:23 host dkms: ERROR: Build failed for nvidia-535/535.86.05
Mar 16 02:14:25 host systemd[1]: Started Node Provisioning Service.
Mar 16 02:14:26 host kubelet[1234]: Failed to register: runtime service unreachable
```
noah: that dkms error line is interesting — suggests mismatch between kernel headers and the compiled module ABI. but nvhost hw_watchdog seems hardware-level too.
kai: canary pattern: gpu nodes with NVLINK attached show it more often. single-GPU test VMs in the same AMI are fine. possible regression when combined with rmmod order on boot.
sara: impact: 6/20 canaries failing -> blocked for rollout to us-west and eu-canary. cost uptick while autoscaler keeps trying to spin more nodes.
lin: quick mitigation: pin canary AMI back to previous (rwinf-worker-2026-03-02) which has nvidia-525 modules baked in; also pause staging of 535 in auto-rollout.
kai: agreed. i'm running a fast rollback on canaries now and adding a kernel-header sanity check in the provisioner preflight. will also add a hook to capture /var/lib/dkms/*/build.log on failure.
noah: filing infra issue and tagging #eng-ml and #eng-runtime so model onboarding knows. suggest a deeper reproduction test: bring up 2-node NVLINK topo and run full nv_test suite during boot.
sara: thanks — keep updates here. if rollback stabilizes, we'll plan a slower canary with additional debug flags (NVreg_ResmanDebugLevel=0x20) before any wider rollout. :thumbsup:
